name: Global Diversity Sum Substitution
description: Replaces the pairwise exclusion condition ("differ in all three parameters") with a global scoring metric. The problem now asks to select k items such that the sum of the number of unique values in each of the three parameter dimensions equals 3k. Since the maximum possible number of unique values in any dimension for k items is k, this sum can only be 3k if all chosen items have distinct values in every dimension. This disguises the 3-Dimensional Matching / Exact Cover structure as a global diversity maximization, which is highly likely to trick models into omitting early pruning during search (leading to TLE) or failing to recognize the exact cover reduction entirely.
